_note: Sample builds for the lab's load menu, from 2-socket twigs to 10-socket archwands. Crystals are listed by zone and flow as one chain: hilt, then shaft, then tip. flanks maps a gap index to a side-slot crystal: gap 0 sits between the 1st and 2nd socket of the whole chain, counting from the hilt. Builds marked doc: true are the design doc's worked examples and double as golden-build tests.

presets.name: A Stick and a Spark
presets.note: Lesson 1: a bare Chalk twig with one Fire crystal.

presets.name: Reed Whistle
presets.note: Two sockets: a fast gust that goes faster.

presets.name: Kettle Twig
presets.note: Two elements side by side fuse. Water core, Fire coat: a Boiling Jet.

presets.name: Apprentice's Tremor
presets.note: Earth in the hilt sets the base; Earth after it makes a Tremor.

presets.name: Tide Wand
presets.note: A Whalebone hilt draws from rain. Try it in the Rain setting.

presets.name: Sparrow Wand
presets.note: A homing Cyclone; the Hollowbone hilt charges while you move.

presets.name: Basalt: Earth → Twinspar → Fire
presets.note: Twinspar between them keeps Earth and Fire apart: two unfused shards, and Fire is paid twice.

presets.name: Basalt: Earth → Fire → Twinspar
presets.note: Earth and Fire side by side fuse into a Volcanic Lob, then split in two. Cheaper.

presets.name: Scalding Lance
presets.note: Fire clashes with the Willow shaft and leaves steam mist. Lancet in the tip pierces a line.

presets.name: Wildfire Reaper
presets.note: A Catalyst side slot between Fire and Wind. Kills refill the Yew hilt.

presets.name: Greed Loop
presets.note: Two feedback loops. One shot is fine; two in a row overload.

presets.name: Golem Breaker
presets.note: A Tidal Wave that bursts. Aim it at the Ember Golem.

presets.name: Inverted Kettle
presets.note: Fire then Water would be a Steam Bomb. The Inverter in the hilt flips it to a Boiling Jet.

presets.name: Mire Mortar
presets.note: Lobs a mud pool over cover. The Lodestone tip pulls toward armor.

presets.name: Wardbreaker
presets.note: A Cold Iron tip and Earth tear through the Iron Knight's ward.

presets.name: Wisp Hunter
presets.note: Silver tip, Wind and homing. Stronger at night.

presets.name: Ember Gambler
presets.note: Runs hot on purpose. Emberpine turns misfires into fire bursts.

presets.name: Frost Net
presets.note: A Rime tip freezes whatever the Water fan touches.

presets.name: Chalk Marker
presets.note: Hits chalk-mark targets; the next shots curve toward them.

presets.name: Storm Shepherd
presets.note: Three homing Storm Bolts that chain, then echo.

presets.name: Hailstorm Fan
presets.note: Wind core, Water coat: Hail, fanned into homing shards.

presets.name: Plasma Lance
presets.note: Storm Bolt + Fire = Plasma, a second-order reaction.

presets.name: Sunburst
presets.note: White Flame through a Quartz shaft and a Prism tip. Best by day.

presets.name: Endless Tide
presets.note: Cheap, wet and sustainable: soaks everything it touches.

presets.name: Dragon's Breath
presets.note: Fire counts double in a Dragon Rib shaft.

presets.name: Geyser Archwand
presets.note: Fire, Water, Earth: Steam Bomb, then Geyser, then a burst that lingers.

presets.name: Grove Archwand
presets.note: Bouncing earth that echoes, then bursts into seedlings at the tip.

presets.name: Starfall Archwand
presets.note: All 10 sockets filled: a fan of homing Storm Bolts that pierce and burst.
